items.question: Which beings and divine range are included as recipients of the bali offering?
premises: The ritual context prescribes giving bali at the eastern seat.
Ancestors, demons, and serpents are named as recipients.
A divine range from Brahma to Aiśāna is included.
items.inference: The bali offering extends to ancestors, demons, serpents, and the full range of deities from Brahma to Aiśāna.
uncertainties: The exact scope implied by the range from Brahma to Aiśāna depends on the ritual layout.
items.plain_english: The ancestors, demons, and serpents, and also the deities from Brahma up to Aiśāna, are to receive the bali offering.
